Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Crime | Regional Motor rider allegedly stabbed to death at Akame Source : GNA 23 October 2026 5:00pm Audio By Carbonatix
A motor rider, identified as Lorlorne Kudah, believed to be in his late 20s, has allegedly been stabbed to death at Akame in the Ketu South Municipality of the Volta Region.
The incident reportedly occurred at about 2100 hours on Thursday, at a new site near the One District, One Factory (1D1F) cassava processing factory.
Assembly Member of the area, Winfred Kwabla Dakunya, told the Ghana News Agency (GNA) that the alleged suspect, identified as Kwame Tsali, believed to be in his 30s and a native of Lotakor, was yet to be apprehended.
He said a woman connected to the incident, who was relatively new to the community, had reportedly informed the police that her husband was responsible for the alleged killing.
Mr Dakunya said the suspect’s father and brother had confirmed that he left home with his motorbike but could not establish when he returned.
He added that the motorbike was reportedly found parked in the suspect’s room after the incident.
The circumstances surrounding the alleged killing remain unclear, and the suspect is reportedly on the run.
Mr Dakunya appealed to residents of Akame and neighbouring communities to remain calm and allow the police to investigate the incident.
He urged anyone with relevant information that could assist in locating the suspect to cooperate with the police.
Police have since commenced investigations into the alleged murder after recovering the body for autopsy.
